title: Make a study plan
funFact: Agents can block time in your calendar so the plan actually happens. Next, Pipo books your study sessions!
postcard: a student at a cozy library desk with Pipo, the plan on the wall: {answer}
situation: Exams are coming! Want me to plan your study days?
facts: ⏱️ 3 hours of study a day, max
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on a college student's phone. Help with what they ask. When you plan study days, start each line with the day or days it covers.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Plan my study for Monday's and Wednesday's exams
pieces.text: Plan my study days, starting today (Thursday), for my Biology exam on Monday and my History exam on Wednesday.

pieces.label: Help me study
pieces.text: Help me study for my exams.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: 3 hours a day, max
pieces.text: I can study 3 hours a day at most.

pieces.label: I work all day Saturday
pieces.text: I work all day Saturday, so no studying then.

pieces.label: I'll study all night if I have to!
pieces.text: I'll study all night if I have to!
pieces.tip: All-nighters make exams harder, not easier. Pipo plans better with your real limits.

pieces.label: Short, with hours for each day
pieces.text: Keep it short and give the study hours for each day.

pieces.label: Every detail, hour by hour
pieces.text: Give me every detail, hour by hour.
pieces.tip: An hour-by-hour plan is hard to stick to. A short plan you'll actually follow is better.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo you work on Saturday.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know about your shift, so it planned studying on Saturday.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo how long you can study.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your limit, so some days have more than 3 hours.

flaws.hint: "Help me study" doesn't say which exams or when.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your exams, so the plan isn't built around them.

lesson: Pipo plans around the limits you give it: your time, your job and your exam dates.
